__comment: Action camera framing. Cut and release are both instant (blend_out_ms 0). side = blocks to the actor's RIGHT, front = blocks along its facing (NEGATIVE = behind). aim_distance = how far ahead of the actor the camera looks; it must BALANCE front, because the min_distance clamp pushes the camera back along the sight line and, when front is far more negative than aim_distance, the shot collapses into a plain behind-the-back view where the actor hides the target. The camera position does NOT depend on body size; width_base/width_scale only push the LOOK-AT POINT further ahead. blend_out_ms in milliseconds.
